title: Agent Tools and Integrations
summary: This module equips AI agents with tools and integrations to interact with the external world, covering foundational frameworks, RAG data retrieval, web search/scraping, and specialized API/sandbox integrations.

nodes.label: Base Tool Framework
nodes.title: Foundational Tool Framework
nodes.description: Defines the core structure, lifecycle, and interoperability mechanisms for all AI agent tools, including schema generation and Langchain compatibility.

nodes.label: RAG Tools & Loaders
nodes.title: RAG Data Tools & Loaders
nodes.description: Provides tools for loading and processing data from various sources (files, web, databases) for Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows, including text chunking.

nodes.label: Search & Scraping Tools
nodes.title: Web Search & Scraping
nodes.description: Offers a suite of tools for performing web searches, extracting content from web pages, and querying diverse structured and unstructured data sources.

nodes.label: Specialized API Tools
nodes.title: External API Integrations
nodes.description: Enables agents to interact with various external APIs and services for data querying, web automation, document processing, and third-party platform integrations.

nodes.label: Sandbox & Bedrock Tools
nodes.title: Sandbox & AWS Bedrock
nodes.description: Provides tools for interacting with AWS Bedrock services (agents, browser, code interpreter, knowledge bases) and external sandbox environments (Daytona, E2B) for code execution.

groups.label: Core Tool Definition
groups.title: Core Tool Framework
groups.description: The foundational module defining the structure, metadata extraction, and execution mechanisms for all AI agent tools.

groups.label: Data Acquisition & Processing
groups.title: Data Acquisition & Processing
groups.description: Modules focused on gathering information from various sources (web, files, databases) and preparing it for use in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows.

groups.label: External Service Integrations
groups.title: External Service Integrations
groups.description: Modules providing specialized tools for interacting with third-party APIs, web automation platforms, and secure sandbox environments for advanced agent capabilities.
